newsitem.title: USA: S&T Bancorp Q1 shr rises to $0.56.
newsitem.headline: S&T Bancorp Q1 shr rises to $0.56.

text.p: S&T Bancorp Inc said first quarter 1997 earnings were $6,248,000 or $0.56. In the year-ago quarter, earnings were $0.50 a share.
Return on assets increased to 1.69 percent for the first three months of 1997, compared with 1.61 percent and 1.63 percent in the first three months of 1996 and the full year of 1996 respectively.

Return on equity increased to 13.94 percent for the first three months of 1997 versus 13.34 percent and 13.75 percent for the first quarter and full year of 1996 respectively. Excluding the large positive FASB 115 adjustment, return on equity was 16.06 percent for the first three months of 1997.
